name: WE: Another World
source:
But first, let us tell you a little more about WE. The story centers around the main character — a university student. He lives a pretty ordinary life: dating a girlfriend, attending classes, having some family issues. It all seems fairly typical... until a new student arrives at the university. Then, the main character learns about a mysterious new VR game...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/release-of-our-127308831]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
但首先，让我们告诉你更多关于WE的信息。故事围绕主角——一名大学生展开。他过着非常平凡的生活：和女朋友约会，上课，有一些家庭问题。这一切似乎都很典型……直到一名新生到达大学。然后，主角得知了一款神秘的新VR游戏……

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/release-of-our-127308831]Patreon[/url]]
